title: Atomic fact — single source of truth for pages, QA gold, and counterfactuals

value_normalized.description: Optional normalized form when the source value is free-form (e.g. TourAPI usetime).

linktype.description: The ONE linktype page this fact is rendered on (unique-placement rule).

relation.description: True for cross-entity relation facts (brand, located_in_region) used for multi-hop QA.

passage.description: Source paragraph the fact is embedded in, verbatim (rendered as-is on the page).

value_span.description: [start, end) character offsets of the value inside passage.
